name: Valheim
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The Viking survival game for up to 10 players. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with BepInEx or Valheim Plus for mods if you want them.
startup: if [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = 1 ]; then ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /home/container +login anonymous +app_update {{SRCDS_APPID}} ${SRCDS_BETAID:+-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID"} ${SRCDS_BETAPASS:+-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS"} $([ "{{VALIDATE}}" = 1 ] && echo validate) +quit || echo "Steam couldn't update the game, so the server starts as it is."; fi; if [ "{{MOD_LOADER}}" != vanilla ]; then if [ -f BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll ]; then export DOORSTOP_ENABLED=1 DOORSTOP_TARGET_ASSEMBLY=./BepInEx/core/BepInEx.Preloader.dll LD_PRELOAD=libdoorstop_x64.so LD_LIBRARY_PATH="./doorstop_libs:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"; else echo "BepInEx isn't installed, so the server starts without mods. Reinstall the server to install it."; fi; fi; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="./linux64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" SteamAppId=892970; exec ./valheim_server.x86_64 -nographics -batchmode -name "{{SERVER_NAME}}" -port {{SERVER_PORT}} -world "{{WORLD}}" -password "{{PASSWORD}}" -public {{PUBLIC_SERVER}} -saveinterval {{BACKUP_INTERVAL}} -backups {{BACKUP_COUNT}} -backupshort {{BACKUP_SHORTTIME}} -backuplong {{BACKUP_LONGTIME}} $([ "{{ENABLE_CROSSPLAY}}" = 1 ] && echo -crossplay) > >(trap '' INT; exec sed -u -E '/^\(Filename: .* Line: [0-9]+\)$/d; /^[[:space:]]*$/d') 2>&1

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Valheim. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 896660) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously, and BepInEx or Valheim Plus when asked.
# Worlds, configs and mods are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-896660}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# BepInEx, the mod loader, for BepInEx and Valheim Plus. Its core files are
# replaced; its config and plugins folders are left alone.
mods="${MOD_LOADER:-vanilla}"
extra=""
if [ "$mods" != vanilla ]; then
    ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
    pack=$(curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" https://thunderstore.io/api/experimental/package/denikson/BepInExPack_Valheim/) ||
        fail "Thunderstore can't be reached right now to download BepInEx. Reinstall to try again."
    bep=$(jq -r '.latest.version_number' <<<"$pack")
    if [ "$(cat BepInEx/.raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$bep" ]; then
        echo "BepInEx $bep is already installed."
    else
        echo "Downloading BepInEx $bep"
        work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
        rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
        trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$work/pack.zip" "$(jq -r '.latest.download_url' <<<"$pack")"
        unzip -q "$work/pack.zip" 'BepInExPack_Valheim/*' -d "$work" || fail "The BepInEx download is damaged. Reinstall to try again."
        src="$work/BepInExPack_Valheim"
        mkdir -p BepInEx/plugins BepInEx/config
        rm -rf BepInEx/core doorstop_libs
        cp -r "$src/BepInEx/core" BepInEx/core
        cp -r "$src/doorstop_libs" doorstop_libs
        cp -f "$src/doorstop_config.ini" "$src/.doorstop_version" .
        [ -f BepInEx/config/BepInEx.cfg ] || cp "$src/BepInEx/config/BepInEx.cfg" BepInEx/config/
        echo "$bep" > BepInEx/.raptor-version
    fi
    extra=" with BepInEx $bep"
fi
if [ "$mods" = valheimplus ]; then
    repo=Grantapher/ValheimPlus
    want="${VERSION:-latest}"
    if ! tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>/dev/null); then
        [ "$want" = latest ] && fail "GitHub can't be reached right now to download Valheim Plus. Reinstall to try again."
        fail "Valheim Plus has no version $want. Set Valheim Plus version to latest, or to one of its releases, such as $(gh-release tag "$repo" latest 2>/dev/null || echo 0.9.13.2)."
    fi
    sum=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk '$1 == "ValheimPlus.dll" { print $2; f = 1 } END { exit !f }') ||
        fail "Valheim Plus $tag has no server download. Choose another version."
    dll=BepInEx/plugins/ValheimPlus.dll
    if [ "$sum" != - ] && [ -f "$dll" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$dll" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
        echo "Valheim Plus $tag is already installed."
    else
        echo "Downloading Valheim Plus $tag"
        gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" ValheimPlus.dll "$dll" || fail "The Valheim Plus download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    fi
    extra=" with Valheim Plus $tag"
fi
echo "Installed Valheim build ${build:-unknown}$extra."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with: at least 5 characters, and not part of the server name.

variables.name: World
variables.description: The world to load, or create when there's none by that name.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: List the server in the in-game server browser. Off, players join by address.

variables.name: Crossplay
variables.description: Let Xbox and Microsoft Store players join, through Microsoft's servers.

variables.name: Mod loader
variables.description: vanilla, bepinex (put mods in BepInEx/plugins), or valheimplus (BepInEx with Valheim Plus). Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Valheim Plus version
variables.description: The Valheim Plus release to install, such as 10.4.0.0, or latest.

variables.name: Save interval
variables.description: How often the world is saved, in seconds.

variables.name: Backups
variables.description: How many of the game's own world backups to keep.

variables.name: First backup after
variables.description: Seconds between the game's first world backups.

variables.name: Later backups every
variables.description: Seconds between the game's later world backups.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, such as staging, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
